## Download

| | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows installer** (recommended) | `NebulaShare-Setup-x.y.z.exe`: installs Nebula Share and adds Start menu and desktop shortcuts |
| **Windows portable** | `NebulaShare-Portable-x.y.z.exe`: one file, no install, just run it |
| **iPhone / iPad** | Open **https://mvpfishstick.github.io/ScreenShare/** in Safari, then tap **Share → Add to Home Screen** |

## How to use

1. Click **Start sharing** and pick a whole screen or a single window.
2. Send your friend the 6-character code, or tap **Copy invite link**.
3. They open Nebula Share (PC or iPhone), enter the code, and see your screen live.

## Features

- Share an entire screen or a single window, with live previews
- Optional system audio (Windows)
- Several viewers at once; switch source without dropping them
- Peer-to-peer and encrypted (WebRTC), no accounts
- iPhone and iPad can watch via the web app

## First launch on Windows

The app isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may say *"Windows protected your PC"*. Click **More info → Run anyway**. If Windows Firewall asks, allow access so viewers can connect.
